messages:
nora: Quick flag for the team: I ran into an onboarding break where jsonMode + tool retries caused a shape/coercion mismatch. Repro and suggested fix below.

nora: Repro summary: callTool(..., jsonMode: true) -> transport emits a single-frame ARRAY -> transient 401 triggers retry -> assembly collapses to OBJECT (first element) -> validator/consumer expects ARRAY -> downstream crash.

nora: Minimal log paste:
```
transport: frame = [{\"item\":1}]
retry: token_refreshed -> replay buffered frame
assembly: collapsed -> {\"item\":1}
validator: schema error: expected ARRAY but got OBJECT
```

max: Ouch. Is this the same class of issue where Node helper doesn't preserve the original "shape" across replayed frames?

nora: Exactly. Python helper preserves a "raw_shape" envelope so the validator can pick correctly; Node assembly lost that metadata during retry.

eli: Two quick options: 1) preserve a lightweight header on the stream (e.g. __rw_shape: "array" / "object") that survives retries, or 2) heuristically collapse single-element arrays to object only when schema explicitly forbids arrays. Option 1 feels less magic.

max: I agree. Shape header avoids guessing and makes parity deterministic. Also easier for validators to do fast-path checks.

nora: Proposal: assembly should attach a transient header on the first frame: {\"__rw_shape\":\"array\"} (not exposed to apps unless debug=true). On retry, keep header when replaying. Validator uses header when present to resolve unions or top-level expected shapes. Fallback: if header missing, existing heuristics apply.

eli: Sounds good. Add a strictJsonMode flag: when true, assembly + validator must never coerce shapes and should fail explicitly. Default stays backwards-compatible (coercion allowed).

max: I'll draft a small PR: 1) add __rw_shape envelope in assembly layer, 2) wire validator to consult envelope, 3) add unit parity tests that replay recorded frames for node and python, 4) add integration test that runs sampleapp onboarding.

devex-bot: Ticket DX-4067 created: "preserve shape envelope across tool retries to avoid jsonMode coercion". Labels: dx, sdk-parity, jsonmode, onboarding.

nora: Thanks — attaching a tiny repro (recorded frames + harness) to DX-4067. This blocked a customer onboarding run; would appreciate a hotfix. :pray: 

eli: Also adding a short doc blurb in onboarding that calls out strictJsonMode and current parity note until the patch lands.

max: Will include sample assembly debug output behind debug=true for easier triage by support.

nora: Great, thanks all :thumbsup:
